# Workflows

- `ci.yml`: pull-request/main lint, full provider-free tests, clean four-target build, default-closed five-package verification, and forbidden-material checks.
- `qualify-npm-runtime.yml`: main-only manual qualification after checked Dream business, four-host, redistribution, and publication gates are all true; uploads exactly five verified tarballs plus aggregate checksums.
- `publish-npm.yml`: validates a successful same-SHA qualification run and npm bootstrap confirmation, re-verifies the immutable five-package set, then publishes four platform packages before the selector. Trusted Publisher OIDC remains preferred; an explicitly selected, scoped and short-lived `npm` Environment `NPM_TOKEN` can be used as a registry-auth fallback without entering source, artifacts, or logs. Token mode removes the GitHub OIDC request carriers and uses npm CLI's highest-priority `--provenance=false` publish override because the qualified tarballs intentionally retain `publishConfig.provenance=true`; it does not mutate tarballs or weaken checksum, manifest, or same-SHA qualification checks.

Only the publish job receives `id-token: write`. Qualification and publication fail closed unless the checked receipt digest, all four target qualifications, and either Trusted Publisher confirmation or the explicit Environment-secret fallback remain exact.
